subject: red panda
title: Red Pandas Eat 20,000 Leaves a Day and Waste Most of Them

scenes.text: Red pandas eat bamboo all day, and still waste most of it.
Bamboo makes up about ninety-five percent of their diet.
But they have the simple stomach of a meat eater. They digest only about a quarter of what they swallow.
So they eat twenty to thirty percent of their body weight every day. One female ate around twenty thousand leaves in a day.
To grip the stems, a wrist bone grew out into a fake thumb.
And when it's cold, they curl up and turn their metabolism down to save energy.

description:
Red pandas live mostly on bamboo but have a simple carnivore stomach, digesting only about 24% of the bamboo they eat.
They eat 20 to 30% of their body weight a day (one female was estimated to eat about 20,000 leaves in a day), grip stems with a false thumb made from a wrist bone, and lower their metabolism in the cold.
